definitions.explanation: A semiconductor device that emits light when current flows through it, used for energy-efficient lighting and displays.

examples.japanese: LED⟦{電球|でんきゅう}→電球：03125_denkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{替|か}えた→替える：13399_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I switched to LED light bulbs.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧LED⟦{照明|しょうめい}→照明：03243_shoumei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧。
examples.english: This room is bright with LED lighting.

examples.japanese: LED⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{従来|じゅうらい}→従来：12511_juurai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電球|でんきゅう}→電球：03125_denkyuu⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{消費|しょうひ}→消費：03240_shouhi⟧⟦{電力|でんりょく}→電力：14609_denryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: LEDs use less power than conventional light bulbs.

notes:
LED lighting has become standard in Japan due to its energy efficiency and long lifespan. LED bulbs and lighting fixtures are sold everywhere, from convenience stores to electronics shops.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- LED⟦{電球|でんきゅう}→電球：03125_denkyuu⟧: LED light bulb
- LED⟦{照明|しょうめい}→照明：03243_shoumei⟧: LED lighting
- LED⟦ライト→ライト：13631_raito⟧: LED light
- LED⟦ディスプレイ→ディスプレイ：04891_disupurei⟧: LED display
- LED⟦{信号機|しんごうき}→信号機：27201_shingouki⟧: LED traffic light

LED is written in the English alphabet in Japanese text. Note that Japanese traffic lights have largely switched to LED.
